title: Opening a report from a Dashboard tile
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin (storage state)
One invoiced Work Order exists for a test-created customer, dated inside LAST calendar month (seeded via API with a backdated invoice date)
A billable technician has closed clock hours on that work order's labour line, inside the same month
custom_steps:
1. Confirm each KPI tile and the Sales by Customer tile shows a report link, and hovering it shows a tooltip naming the report it opens.
2. Select a tile's report link and confirm it opens that tile's matching report, opened with the date range the tile currently shows.
3. Confirm the At Risk Customers tile shows no report link (there is no At Risk report).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each KPI tile and the Sales by Customer tile shows a report link.
  • Selecting a tile's report link opens that tile's matching report.
  • The report opens with the date range the tile currently shows.
  • Hovering a tile's report link shows a tooltip naming the report the link opens.
  • The At Risk Customers tile shows no report link, because there is no At Risk report.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9582 (S10 — Report Drill-In); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S10; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R1: “Each KPI tile and the Sales by Customer tile shows a report link.”
  • S10-R2: “Selecting a tile's report link opens that tile's matching report.”
  • S10-R3: “The report opens with the date range the tile currently shows.”
  • S10-R4: “Hovering a tile's report link shows a tooltip naming the report the link opens.”
  • S10-N1: “The At Risk Customers tile shows no report link, because there is no At Risk report.”
